question: Should OpenClaw permanently own the Discord progress configuration and cross-runtime plugin/lifecycle contracts introduced by this PR?
rationale: The cleanup bug has a narrow mechanical repair, but accepting seven settings, requester message metadata, a channel lifecycle adapter, and persisted cleanup state is an enduring product and API ownership choice.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Accept the feature after cleanup correctness, current-main integration, and exact-head Discord proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Keep basic count and failure feedback while reducing configurable and plugin-visible contracts.

options.title: Pause adoption
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers approve a smaller ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the feature after cleanup correctness, current-main integration, and exact-head Discord proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans the affected Discord, channel-plugin, hook-contract, and subagent registry surfaces.
